verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a vendor-hosted checkout page or payment link that customers can be redirected to. The Web Payments SDK (square-docs-31) is an embeddable payment UI, and the eCommerce-provider integrations (square-docs-46) are third-party connections, not a hosted checkout. The only nearby hint is that 'checkout' appears as a service name in the MCP server's catalog, which does not show a redirectable, conversion-optimized hosted page.
